categories.main_business_segments: BYD Company Limited operates primarily in the automobile business focusing on new energy vehicles, handset components and assembly services, rechargeable batteries, and photovoltaics. Additionally, the Group actively develops urban rail transportation. The automobile segment includes battery electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, with multiple brands such as BYD, Denza, and Yangwang. The handset components segment serves consumer electronics and new intelligent products markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group leverages advanced technologies including Blade Batteries (highly safe LFP batteries), DM-i Super Hybrid, e-Platform 3.0, CTB Cell-to-Body Integration, and DM-p Hybrid technologies. It emphasizes vertical integration in manufacturing, covering new materials development, product design, R&D, components and machine manufacturing, supply chain management, and logistics. The urban rail segment develops proprietary medium-capacity SkyRail and low-capacity SkyShuttle systems. The photovoltaics business covers the full industrial chain from silicon wafer to system application.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading consumer electronics manufacturers such as Samsung and Dell, and professional robot brands like Ecovacs. The automobile segment serves the passenger vehicle market in China and overseas markets including Europe, Asia Pacific, Americas, Australia, Japan, Brazil, Indonesia, and Mauritius. The handset components business serves global smartphone, tablet, smart home, game hardware, drone, IoT, robot, communication equipment, and medical device markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: BYD operates primarily in China (including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan) and has expanded aggressively into overseas markets such as Europe, Asia Pacific, the Americas, Australia, Japan, Brazil, Indonesia, and Mauritius. The first wholly-owned overseas passenger vehicle plant was established in Thailand. The Group’s revenue is predominantly from the PRC market (78.43% in 2022) with growing overseas sales (21.57% in 2022).
categories.supply_chain_position: BYD operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer covering upstream (battery and materials development), midstream (components and assembly), and downstream (vehicle manufacturing and urban rail systems) segments. It controls core technologies and production capacities, including power batteries and vehicle assembly, and provides one-stop services from R&D to after-sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes technological innovation with focus on core technologies for new energy vehicles, including the launch of the e4 Platform with four-motor independent drive. It invests heavily in R&D for battery technology, intelligent driving, and photovoltaics. The Group also emphasizes market-oriented operations, strategic investments in core industry chain areas, and expanding new intelligent product segments such as smart home devices, game hardware, and drones.
categories.revenue_model: BYD generates revenue primarily through product sales including new energy vehicles, handset components and assembly services, rechargeable batteries, and photovoltaic products. It also earns from related services such as supply chain management and after-sales. The Group’s revenue is largely from direct sales to automotive customers and handset manufacturers, with additional income from industrial investments and capital operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BYD is a global pioneer and leader in the new energy vehicle industry, holding the No.1 position in China’s new energy vehicle sales for ten consecutive years and leading globally. It competes with other major new energy vehicle manufacturers and battery producers worldwide. Its vertically integrated model and proprietary technologies provide competitive advantages in safety, performance, and cost efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, BYD reported revenue of RMB 424.06 billion, a 96.20% increase year-on-year, driven mainly by new energy vehicle sales. Profit attributable to owners surged 445.86% to RMB 16.62 billion. The Group’s market share in new energy vehicles reached 27% in 2022, up nearly 10 percentage points from 2021. It employs approximately 570,100 staff and maintains strong liquidity with operating cash inflows of RMB 140.84 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BYD emphasizes its technological superiority, including disruptive battery technologies like Blade Batteries and integrated vehicle-battery designs enhancing safety and performance. Its multi-brand strategy caters to diverse consumer needs from mass market to luxury segments. The Group’s vertical integration enables rapid response to market changes and comprehensive service offerings, while its urban rail solutions address urban transportation challenges with efficient, low-cost, and green technologies.
